meta.note: Values are VS Code's own defaults for Default Dark+, Default Light+ and Default High Contrast, recorded so specs can be drawn and contrast checked. The extension never ships a hex: every colour is a ThemeColor id, so user themes win.

tokens.name: activityBar.background
tokens.usage: VS Code built-in. Reference ThemeColor('activityBar.background'), never the hex. Activity bar strip behind the Sextant glyph.

tokens.name: activityBar.foreground
tokens.usage: VS Code built-in. Reference ThemeColor('activityBar.foreground'), never the hex. Active activity-bar icon (the Sextant glyph when its container is open).

tokens.name: activityBar.inactiveForeground

tokens.name: foreground

tokens.name: descriptionForeground

tokens.name: contrastActiveBorder

tokens.name: list.inactiveSelectionBackground

tokens.name: list.hoverBackground

tokens.name: list.errorForeground

tokens.name: terminal.ansiBlack

tokens.name: terminal.ansiBrightWhite
tokens.usage: VS Code built-in. Reference ThemeColor('terminal.ansiBrightWhite'), never the hex. ANSI 97: text of the PROD chip on ansiRed. VS Code's terminal.integrated.minimumContrastRatio (default 4.5) lifts it where the theme value is too faint (Light+).

tokens.name: sextant.env.prodForeground
tokens.usage: Sextant-contributed (contributes.colors; users can override in workbench.colorCustomizations). Prod environment icon and the 'critical' group description. Default: list.errorForeground (HC: errorForeground). Always paired with $(warning) + the word 'critical'.

tokens.name: sextant.env.stagingForeground
tokens.usage: Sextant-contributed (contributes.colors; users can override in workbench.colorCustomizations). Staging group icon. Default: list.warningForeground. Paired with $(beaker) + 'staging'.

tokens.name: sextant.env.devForeground

tokens.name: sextant.env.untaggedForeground
tokens.usage: Sextant-contributed (contributes.colors; users can override in workbench.colorCustomizations). Untagged group icon. Default: icon.foreground (deliberately neutral). Paired with $(question) + 'Untagged'.

tokens.name: sextant.risk.expiredForeground
tokens.usage: Sextant-contributed (contributes.colors; users can override in workbench.colorCustomizations). Credential Audit 'Expired' group and row icon ($(error)). Default: list.errorForeground.

tokens.name: sextant.risk.longLivedForeground
tokens.usage: Sextant-contributed (contributes.colors; users can override in workbench.colorCustomizations). 'Long-lived credentials' icon ($(warning)). Default: list.warningForeground.

tokens.name: sextant.risk.expiringForeground
tokens.usage: Sextant-contributed (contributes.colors; users can override in workbench.colorCustomizations). 'Expiring within 30 days' icon ($(watch)). Default: editorInfo.foreground.

tokens.name: sextant.risk.shortLivedForeground
tokens.usage: Sextant-contributed (contributes.colors; users can override in workbench.colorCustomizations). 'Short-lived or brokered' icon ($(verified)). Default: charts.green.

tokens.name: sextant.currentContextForeground
tokens.usage: Sextant-contributed (contributes.colors; users can override in workbench.colorCustomizations). $(pass-filled) on the current context row. Default: charts.green. The word 'current' in the description carries the same meaning.
